coverage.title: @Claudia1516322 @Rafaelita154911 @OpenAI GPT-4o was retired from ChatGPT on Feb 13 2026 after daily usage dropped to 0.1%. Some API snapshots remain available for now. No official plans exist for an archival open-weight release, though OpenAI has open-sourced other models like gpt-oss.
